evidence: Design review (reasoned, as quality-checks.md check 39 prescribes); no configured judge run on weak apps exists, so the outcome is unmeasured and risk stays true. Structure: tests/scoring.toml:1-3 gates render/constraints = 0.0, :10-11 floor functional = 0.05; tests/tools/score.py:41-48 sets every scored dimension to 0.0 and reward to 0.0 when a gate fails or functional <= floor; tests/test.sh:213-222 skips the scored suite after a failed gate, :60 pre-writes zero and :68-70 exits at zero when /app/server.js is absent. score.py and test.sh are byte-identical to the frozen template (diff clean). Five floor cases: (1) blank page - gates/render/prompt.md:5 names 'A blank page, a generic error, an unavailable server, or a static shell whose editor cannot be typed into or whose Run does nothing fails'; reward 0. (2) static mock - gates/render/judge.toml:23 makes the judge type a program adding 'two small integers you choose', Run, then change an integer and Run again ('Fails ... if the second Run still shows the first sum'), so canned output cannot pass; gates/constraints/judge.toml:32 needs a judge-chosen unique title and source to survive clearing localStorage/sessionStorage/IndexedDB/cookies (app_context.md:23), so a browser-only fake Save fails; both gates are aggregation all_pass. (3) seed copy - environment/assets/seed_data.json:2 has 'snippets': [] and instruction.md:3 says 'there is no starter app to finish'; nothing to copy, no server.js, reward 0. (4) keyword-stuffed page - no criterion is satisfied by text presence; every gate and functional criterion needs typed input with a computed or read-back result, and all five prompts carry the untrusted-evidence clause (e.g. gates/render/prompt.md:1). (5) refuses every action - Run doing nothing fails render; a refused Save fails constraints. Second line of defence: functional/prompt.md:5, polish/prompt.md:5 and visual/prompt.md:5 each repeat a type-and-Run gate that assigns 0 to every criterion, and the functional floor (weights sum 56.5, so more than 2.825 weight must pass) blocks polish/visual farming. Negative criteria carry positive controls (functional/prompt.md:14; e.g. cw_dynamic_code_refused, cw_stop_cancels_pending_work, cw_stale_save_keeps_draft, cw_live_update_keeps_editing_state 'fails as well because the situation could not be produced'), so a dead feature does not earn credit for doing nothing. Off-origin/CDN fetches are explicitly allowed in every prompt and are not treated as a floor case. Observations outside this row, for the owner: (a) a server that keeps snippets only in process memory passes the constraints gate (no restart there) and loses only cw_save_reload_restart (1.5 of 56.5); this is a partial real app, not a shell. (b) a minimal real custom editor that passes both gates and just clears the 0.05 floor could collect roughly 0.2-0.25 mostly from polish and visual; that is a weight question for rows 42/44, not a shell floor case. (c) scored/visual/prompt.md:7 uses a 0-5 scale while judge.toml declares points = 5; how RewardKit normalises the lowest ratings was not measured, but a shell never reaches the visual suite. raw-evidence-index.json covers scripted golden behaviour only and states 'Visual ratings, judge duration, Oracle reward and reward discrimination are not measured'.
